question: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.

details.reason: Complete results match Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 1.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.time
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON g.gas_station_id = t.gas_station_id
WHERE g.chain_id = 11
ORDER BY t.time;
details.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.time FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id WHERE T2.chain_id = 11
